canonical_resume_binding.label: August 2026 canonical resume
canonical_resume_binding.role: Primary authority for positioning, chronology, titles, dates, current-role framing, and resume-cleared claims.

public_safety.rule: A fact may exist privately without being admissible for public use.

claims.canonical_public_wording: I stabilize and scale growth systems by connecting investment allocation, CRO, measurement, agency governance, marketing operations, and executive decision support.
prohibited_inference: Do not reduce the positioning to channel optimization alone.
Do not imply ownership of every business outcome produced by a broader organization.

claims.canonical_public_wording: 15+ years across media investment, CRO, measurement, agency governance, and marketing operations.
prohibited_inference: Do not convert years of broad growth experience into unsupported years for a narrower specialty.

claims.canonical_public_wording: Current work sits inside a $700M PE-backed education enterprise.
prohibited_inference: This is an enterprise-scale descriptor, not company revenue, personal P&L ownership, or value created by Jared.

claims.canonical_public_wording: Lead $15M+ in media investment across a complex education portfolio.
prohibited_inference: Do not imply formal enterprise P&L ownership or that all company marketing spend sits in this scope.

claims.canonical_public_wording: Operate across a portfolio of 180+ institutions.
prohibited_inference: Do not imply identical responsibility or media activity at every institution.

claims.canonical_public_wording: Rebuilt performance media and CRO into a governed operating model across three business units.
prohibited_inference: Do not imply direct-line ownership of every function inside the three business units.

claims.canonical_public_wording: Established a five-workstream CRO operating model with shared standards for conversion logic, taxonomy, QA, pacing, reporting, escalation, and ownership.
prohibited_inference: Do not describe five workstreams as five isolated tests or five business units.

claims.canonical_public_wording: Redirected $500K in media investment across priority markets based on portfolio needs and allocation tradeoffs.
prohibited_inference: Do not translate the reallocation into unsupported incremental revenue, profit, or savings.

claims.canonical_public_wording: Following a broader nine-school channel-mix correction, lead-to-enrollment improved from approximately 17% to 28%, informing subsequent allocation planning.
prohibited_inference: Never attribute the improvement solely to YouTube or a single channel.
Do not convert lead-to-enrollment into revenue or profit.

claims.canonical_public_wording: Scaled acquisition and conversion infrastructure across 150+ custom landing pages.
prohibited_inference: Do not describe 150+ pages as 150+ experiments or claim a conversion lift without separate evidence.

claims.canonical_public_wording: Restructured 60+ campaigns in under four weeks during a high-pressure enrollment period.
prohibited_inference: Do not imply the restructure alone caused later business outcomes without evidence.

claims.canonical_public_wording: Reset agency governance across media, creative, analytics, and CRO by tightening scope, pricing, budget controls, performance accountability, and in-housing decision rights.
prohibited_inference: Do not imply every partner was replaced or that in-housing is always the preferred model.

claims.canonical_public_wording: Strengthened Google/Meta-to-Salesforce measurement, offline and deep-funnel conversion signals, and QA so investment decisions could increasingly optimize toward applications and enrollments rather than lead volume alone.
prohibited_inference: Do not claim perfect attribution, formal MMM ownership, or causal certainty not supported by the source.

claims.canonical_public_wording: Led enterprise strategy and delivery quality across $10M+ in annual media investment while restructuring the firm's largest paid media division.
prohibited_inference: Do not imply company-wide revenue ownership or that the $10M+ was a single client budget.

claims.canonical_public_wording: Approved applications grew approximately 500% after a phased account rebuild and tighter investment discipline.
prohibited_inference: Approved applications are not revenue, profit, subscriptions, or enterprise value.
Do not imply sole causality by one tactic.

claims.canonical_public_wording: Rebuilt paid media operations for a $250M+ advocacy and philanthropic network.
prohibited_inference: Do not present $250M+ as media budget, revenue owned, or value created by Jared.

claims.canonical_public_wording: Managed three direct reports while rebuilding paid media operations.
prohibited_inference: Do not use this as Jared's maximum team scale; Essence provides the larger team example.

claims.canonical_public_wording: Delivered 86% year-over-year growth in web-qualified engagements while outperforming benchmarks by three times.
prohibited_inference: Web-qualified engagements are not revenue.
Three times refers to benchmark outperformance, not a 3x growth rate unless a source explicitly says so.

claims.canonical_public_wording: Achieved 85% cost savings for an online pharmacy client through tighter channel and messaging strategy.
prohibited_inference: Do not generalize the savings across all TBC clients or convert it into revenue growth.

claims.canonical_public_wording: Increased brand SEO adoption by 50% through training and an implementation guide.
prohibited_inference: Do not translate adoption into revenue or search-performance lift without separate evidence.

claims.canonical_public_wording: Surpassed sub-brand revenue targets by more than $500K year over year through CDP integration and audience strategy.
prohibited_inference: Do not imply company-wide revenue lift, audited finance ownership, or that media alone caused the result.

claims.canonical_public_wording: Directed global digital investment across $100M+ programs spanning North America, EMEA, APJ, and LATAM.
prohibited_inference: Do not collapse program scale into company revenue or imply every named historical client individually had a $100M+ program.

claims.canonical_public_wording: Led 30+ person teams spanning media, analytics, and strategy across global programs.
prohibited_inference: Do not imply all 30+ were direct reports.

claims.canonical_public_wording: Doubled managed investment to $100M by replacing keyword-first planning with an audience-segmentation strategy.
prohibited_inference: Do not convert managed-investment growth into client revenue or profit.

claims.canonical_public_wording: Build and use AI-enabled workflows for performance monitoring, marketing-operations automation, governance, QA, and decision support while keeping accountable human judgment in the loop.
prohibited_inference: Do not imply autonomous business decision-making, private-data publication, or production scale not demonstrated by the public repositories.

claims.canonical_public_wording: Public portfolio materials cite alignment across 21 distinct platforms in one Google environment.
prohibited_inference: Do not imply the 21 platforms represent all Google or Alphabet media activity.
Do not translate platform alignment into a revenue or performance outcome.
